# x402-phonetic-encoder

Soundex + lightweight Double-Metaphone phonetic encoding microservice.
Agent-native, no-human-in-loop, exact USDC micropayments via x402 on Base.

## Endpoints
- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/phonetic — paid

## Pricing
~0.003–0.007 USDC per call (exact scheme)

## Usage
Send POST with JSON { "text": "...", "algorithms?": ["soundex","metaphone"] }
Receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
